body.purpose: Running text in the max-w-3xl column.

body-small.purpose: Tables, hints, meta lines; the most used size.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrow after the route stop.

shadows.name: hairline-card-rule
shadows.purpose: Card bottom edge, with a 1px hairline ring.

shadows.name: accent-press-edge
shadows.purpose: Keycap edge under the coral button; 1px on hover.

shadows.name: stop-halo
shadows.purpose: Cuts the local stop out of its line.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus; Night Focus #d7b4ff on night panels.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active state on buttons and triggers.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: Busy buttons, only when motion is allowed.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion removes animation and smooth scroll.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action. Teal, 44px tall, pill today.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0a6b67; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #085754; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #064441; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5a2d86; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The one call to action that matters most; coral with ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e2603a; color: #121820; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 0 #064441; transition: transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 #064441; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5a2d86; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quieter action: white with a 2px teal border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid #0a6b67; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #0a6b67; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e0f0ee; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5a2d86; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: White card with a hairline ring and bottom rule; flat at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #121820; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d3dad8, 0 1px 0 0 #d3dad8; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #4d5666; } .ds-card-figure { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: 'Overpass Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Small status word; never colour alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e0f1e6; color: #196a3e; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Text Field
components.html: Helper text sits under the field.
components.css: .ds-field label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-weight: 600; color: #121820; } .ds-field input { display: block; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 12px; border: 2px solid #4d5666; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #121820; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #0a6b67; outline: 3px solid #5a2d86; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field p { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #4d5666; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Section label after a short teal route line ending in a coral stop.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a83c1b; } .ds-stop { position: relative; display: inline-block; flex: none; width: 24px; height: 12px; } .ds-stop::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; right: 6px; height: 3px; margin-top: -1.5px; border-radius: 2px; background: #0a6b67; } .ds-stop::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 0; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-top: -5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e2603a; }

components.name: Merchant Card
components.description: Participating merchant: teal rail with a coral stop on the left. Never for candidates.
components.css: .ds-merchant { position: relative; padding: 20px 20px 20px 24px; border-left: 5px solid #0a6b67; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d3dad8; } .ds-merchant::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 1.4rem; left: -0.7rem; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #e2603a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #fff; } .ds-merchant-name { margin: 0; font-family: 'Overpass Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #121820; } .ds-merchant-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #4d5666; }

narrative.overview:
Clear civic wayfinding. One teal line runs through the product, one coral stop marks the local place you are sending people to, and everything else stays quiet: pale grey-green paper, white cards held by hairlines, ink-dark text. The interface should read as a calm, credible benefits product to an HR manager within ten seconds, and as a place a tired employee can pay for lunch on a phone without thinking.

Money, fraud-hold and admin screens follow a second rule, Ledger Desk precision: the numbers and the rules lead, figures are tabular, tables are plain and the route motif steps back. The motif is wayfinding, not wallpaper; it appears in three places only (section eyebrows, the landing hero's route line, participating merchant cards).

The system is deliberately restrained. It rejects generic AI-product decoration: gradients, glows, emoji, piles of cards and badges, rounded-everything. It also rejects the retired earlier look (forest, cream, paper, amber, sage, the awning).
keyCharacteristics: Teal for the line and the main action; coral used rarely, for the local stop.
Flat surfaces: hairline rings, no decorative shadows, tonal night panels for depth.
Overpass for headings and every digit, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for text.
Every state visible: hover, pressed (1px down), busy (spinner), unavailable (grey, not see-through).
44px tap targets and a 3px focus ring everywhere; dark mode mirrors every token.
Not yet tried in a real browser with a screen reader or on a real phone.

rules.name: The One Local Stop Rule
rules.body: Coral marks the local stop and the single call to action that matters most on a screen. If a screen has two coral things, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Line Is Not A Boundary Rule
rules.body: `line` is decoration. A control's border uses `edge`, so it meets 3:1.

rules.name: The Pairs Are Tested Rule
rules.body: Any new text/background pair is added to `ColorContrast::PAIRS` and passes in light and dark before it ships.

rules.name: The Plain Figures Rule
rules.body: Money is set with `tabular` (tabular, lining figures) so columns align and zeros read as zeros.

rules.name: The No Third Font Rule
rules.body: Two families, no more. Hierarchy comes from size and weight, not new faces.

rules.name: The Phone Is The Card Rule
rules.body: Design the 320px phone first; desktop is the same page given room.

rules.name: The Honesty Line Rule
rules.body: Demo, projection and "not measured" labels never sit in anything hidden on phones.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: No decorative shadow, glow or blur. A shadow, when present, is a part (an edge, a halo, a ring), not an atmosphere.

dos: Do keep teal as the line and main action, and coral as the single local stop.
Do put control borders on `edge` (#7a8494) and decoration on `line`.
Do use Overpass for headings and digits, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for text, with `tabular` on money.
Do show every state: hover, pressed (1px down), busy, unavailable, focus (3px ring).
Do keep tap targets at 44px and fields at 16px or more on phones.
Do centre the hero, page titles and main column; keep body text, lists, tables and forms left-aligned.
Do let ledger, money, fraud-hold and admin screens lead with numbers and plain tables, with the route motif stepped back.
Do add any new colour pair to `ColorContrast::PAIRS` and keep the two dark blocks in `app.css` identical.
Do use `<x-rtable>`, `<x-breakable>` and `<x-eyebrow>` rather than hand-rolling their patterns.
donts: Don't reintroduce forest, cream, paper, amber, sage or the awning.
Don't add a new font, a new colour world or a new tagline; the Transit lines brand (ADR 0025) is binding.
Don't use gradients, glows, emoji, decorative blur, or heavy shadows; no `shadow-lg` or `shadow-xl` on new work.
Don't stack cards in cards, or add cards and badges where plain text and a rule will do.
Don't use the route motif beyond eyebrows, the landing route line and participating merchant cards; never put a merchant rail on a candidate.
Don't hide demo, projection or honesty lines in anything that is hidden on phones.
Don't convey status by colour alone, and don't remove, merge, hide or rename content or navigation in a design pass: visual changes only.
